title: Just..... OK.
text: Just..... OK.. I am a bit disappointed with these storage containers. The fact that it breaks down/or build up is kind of a gimmick in my opinion. It's very weak and the sides and door do pop open and come apart. Putting a pair of sneakers in these feel like a waste so I've utilized the containers for my cosmetics/nail polishes and instruments/hair products and hair tools. It'd be really great if they were sturdier but they work for what I intended them for.
